topic: Why a plumber's Google listing gets views but no calls (Step 2)
title: Easy to Call | Why Your Plumber Gets Views but No Calls
description: Easy to Call. From our full video: Why Your Plumber Gets Views but No Calls.

scenes.narration: Step 2: Make calling frictionless. Use a single visible phone number and a click-to-call button. If you use a tracking number, route calls to your main line. Test the number from different phones to make sure it rings.

Example: Bakery routine. Use the same number on Google, your site, and Facebook. If you add a local tracking number, expect a small monthly fee — around ten dollars a month [CHECK: price]. Make sure it forwards to your main phone.
